summary.text: Sylvia Grot is the Republican candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 59 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
She previously sought the Republican nomination in the 2022 special primary for Michigan House of Representatives District 36, which Terence Mekoski won.
